items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor roadmap, and owner repository context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, product terminology, Editor AGENTS.md, and old Editor roadmap Task 6 are reviewed before implementation.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor, phase target phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-columns-authoring-boundary, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-columns-authoring-boundary, and evidence target evidence-editor-columns-authoring-boundary-2026-08-31 before record edits.

items.label: Write failing Editor and Project Control tests before accepting Columns authoring readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: Columns readiness, visible add actions, Paper/projection container facts, and Project Control registration fail before implementation or record edits.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included columnsAuthoringReadiness failing because the module did not exist; addNodeVisibleActions failing because Text still targeted the Columns surface and selected column text still exposed Columns insert; nodePresentation/Paper tests failing because column ids were missing from projection/markup; and Project Control Work Queue failing because this phase was not registered.

items.label: Resolve selected Columns and Column containers to concrete Text append placements.
items.evidenceTarget: Selected Columns uses a concrete Column child such as summary-left, and selected Column containers append Text to themselves.
items.verificationNote: columnsAuthoringReadiness tests prove selected summary-columns resolves to summary-left for text append, and selected summary-right resolves directly to a text append placement under summary-right.

items.label: Keep selected text inside Columns scoped to same-parent sibling placement and block cross-column placement.
items.evidenceTarget: Selected text inside a Column inserts beside siblings in the same Column only; cross-column placement returns an explicit blocked reason.
items.verificationNote: createColumnTextSiblingPlacement returns ready before/after placements under summary-left for summary-left-text and blocks targeting summary-right with a reason naming the mismatch.

items.label: Route visible Structure Text actions to Column containers without exposing broader unsupported actions.
items.evidenceTarget: Visible Text actions carry the concrete container id and selected column text no longer exposes Columns insert beside it.
items.verificationNote: addNodeVisibleActions tests prove Text on selected Columns appends to summary-left, Text on selected summary-left-text inserts after it inside summary-left, append actions target summary-left, and Columns insert is absent from selected column text actions.

items.label: Expose container facts in Structure and Paper markup without changing visible copy or enabling WYSIWYG.
items.evidenceTarget: Outline add buttons include data-outline-add-container, and Paper columns preview text descendants include data-canvas-column-id/data-canvas-columns-id.
items.verificationNote: Outline scannability, nodePresentation, and PaperBlock tests prove container facts are present while visible labels stay Text/Columns and contenteditable/textarea are not introduced by this slice.

items.label: Run Editor worktree and merged-main gates, record Project Control evidence, and keep maps unchanged.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Editor tests, full Editor check, no-write live Backend smoke, and Project Control record tests support the bounded evidence record.
items.verificationNote: Editor worktree and merged main passed focused 8-file/37-test gate, npm run check with 104 test files and 376 tests plus build, and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke. Project Control records are added without map promotion.
